plan.title: Paired 3-condition blood DE: control vs treated_a vs treated_b
plan.analytical_narrative: Four subjects each contribute a control, treated_a, and treated_b blood sample (12 samples, single batch), with 12000 genes quantified by Salmon as raw integer counts. The design is a within-subject repeated measures with three levels, so the subject must be blocked in the model to remove between-subject variation before testing the treatment effect. We run sample-structure QC to confirm subjects cluster by condition and no sample is an outlier, then fit DESeq2 with design ~ subject + condition. An omnibus likelihood-ratio test (full ~ subject + condition vs reduced ~ subject) identifies genes with any effect of either treatment within a subject; three pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b) then resolve the specific question of whether the two treatments differ from each other and from control. Log2 fold changes are shrunk with ashr (contrasts between non-reference levels are not single coefficients, so apeglm does not apply to the A-vs-B contrast). Multiple testing is BH-adjusted within each contrast at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering. Because the knowledge-base check flags that a preranked GSEA is not the licensed enrichment method for this exact situation, enrichment is run as over-representation analysis (ORA) with an explicit tested-gene universe against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome (both staged locally for human), applied per contrast, with the caveat that ORA on a short significant list has low power and should be read as hypothesis-generating. Everything is reported per contrast with diagnostics, shrinkage tables, and the overlap between the omnibus 'any treatment effect' gene set and each pairwise comparison.

steps.method: vst(blind) PCA, sample distance heatmap, library sizes

~ subject + condition, reference level = control, gene-level counts already provided (no tximport offset available)
DESeq2 LRT (full ~subject+condition vs reduced ~subject) for omnibus test, then Wald contrasts treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b
ashr shrinkage on each pairwise contrast
Benjamini-Hochberg within each contrast, alpha=0.05, independent filtering on
fgsea preranked on Wald stat, Hallmark then Reactome, per contrast
Combined DE + enrichment report with diagnostics

Over-representation analysis (clusterProfiler enricher) on significant genes per contrast against MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome, with the tested genes as the explicit universe
